voice.note: speaker → script/cast.json (voice, speed, pitch). Per line: speed (× the speaker's), pre/post (ms of silence before/after the voice), say (what is spoken, if not `text`). captionY (px or "high") lifts the caption above low action.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI), Adi Parva, Astika sub-parva, adhyaya 29 (first part): Garuda finds the soma surrounded by a fire that covers the sky; he makes himself ninety times ninety mouths, drinks rivers and puts the fire out with them; he makes himself small and golden and goes in; before the soma spins an iron wheel with razor-sharp edges, made by the gods to cut down thieves; he finds the gap between its spokes, shrinks and passes through; beneath it lie two great serpents with blazing eyes whose gaze is poison; he blinds them with dust, cuts them down unseen, breaks the wheel and flies out with the soma, not drinking it. (The cliffhanger looks ahead: Vishnu meets him in the sky.)
structure: From episode 21 (independent review): COLD OPEN (≤ 8 words, ≤ 3 s; opening style A: the question over the answer image) → title (hook post) → STORY from ≈ 5 s with the UNVOICED recap band over its first shot (KIT.series.recapBand) → turn at 40–60 % → the cliffhanger image + line → a ≤ 1.2 s NEXT › band over the cliffhanger image that dissolves into frame 1 (KIT.series.overlayNextScene). No fire edge in the Garuda arc from here.

strings.recapLine: The gods fled. Fire and a wheel guarded the amrita.

lines.speaker: sauti
lines.text: How do you pass a wheel of blades?
lines.say: How do you pass [p:60] a wheel of blades?
lines.note: COLD OPEN (style A, moving from frame 1): the iron wheel spinning LARGE, its blades flashing past the camera; through the gap between spokes, the white glow of the amrita.

lines.text: First, a fire that reached the sky.
lines.say: First, [p:80] a fire that reached the sky.
lines.note: STORY 1 with the unvoiced recap band: NEW LIGHT, the inner court of the amrita, all fire: a wall of flame from floor to sky; Garuda small before it.

lines.text: He made himself ninety times ninety mouths, drank whole rivers, and poured them on the fire.
lines.say: He made himself ninety times ninety mouths, [p:100] drank whole rivers, [p:80] and poured them on the fire.
lines.note: STORY 2: a gold counter '90 × 90 · mouths' on beats[0]; rivers drawn up into him in silver ribbons (beats[1..2]); poured down, the fire hisses into steam (beats[3]).

lines.text: Then he made himself small, and bright as gold.
lines.say: Then he made himself small, [p:100] and bright as gold.
lines.note: STORY 3: through the steam, Garuda shrinks to a small figure blazing gold.

lines.text: Before the amrita spun a wheel of iron, its rim all blades.
lines.say: Before the amrita spun a wheel of iron, [p:120] its rim all blades.
lines.note: STORY 4: the reveal: the wheel, LARGE and frontal, spinning before the glowing pot; its blades sing.

lines.text: The gods had made it to cut down any thief.
lines.say: The gods had made it [p:80] to cut down any thief.
lines.note: STORY 4b: close on the rim: the blades flash past, one after another, singing.

lines.text: He found the gap between its spokes, and slipped through.
lines.say: He found the gap between its spokes, [p:120] and slipped through.
lines.note: STORY 5: the tiny gold Garuda times the spokes and darts through a gap (beats[1]); seen from behind him.

lines.speaker: sauti
lines.text: But two more guards were waiting.
lines.say: But two more guards were waiting.
lines.note: FRAME (Sauti at the Naimisha fire, a sixteenth angle: from behind Sauti's back, his hand raised with two fingers, the sages' faces lit beyond him).

lines.text: Beneath it lay two great serpents, their eyes like fire, never closing, their very gaze poison.
lines.say: Beneath it lay two great serpents, [p:80] their eyes like fire, [p:60] never closing, [p:80] their very gaze poison.
lines.note: STORY 6 · THE TURN (≈ 52 %): after a 0.9 s rest (the episode's one long rest), the reveal beneath the wheel: the two guardian serpents rear, ember eyes unblinking; Garuda small between them.

lines.text: He filled their eyes with dust, and cut them down.
lines.say: He filled their eyes with dust, [p:120] and cut them down.
lines.note: STORY 7: a cloud of dust thrown up by his wings; their eyes grey out (beats[0]); a flash of talons and they sink (beats[1]) (no gore: they fall back into shadow).

lines.text: He broke the wheel, and flew off with the amrita, without drinking a drop.
lines.say: He broke the wheel, [p:100] and flew off with the amrita, [p:120] without drinking a drop.
lines.note: STORY 8: the wheel shatters (beats[0]); Garuda, full size again, bursts upward holding the white pot (beats[1]); he does not lift it to his beak (beats[2]).

lines.text: On his way out, he met Vishnu.
lines.say: On his way out, [p:150] he met Vishnu.
lines.note: NEXT 1 (cliffhanger, the catalog line): the open sky; ahead of Garuda a deep-blue light opens: Narayana (Vishnu) waiting in the air, his discus behind him.
The short Next over the cliffhanger image; dissolve into frame 1.
